name: xcode-overlay-service
goal: Recognize only the selected signed Xcode overlay service after verified system adoption; preserve refusal of lookalikes and unproven leftovers.

evidence: The real immutable native build passed all six assertions but failed cleanup because an Interface Builder overlay child outlived ibtoold. The selected Xcode signs this exact service as com.apple.InterfaceBuilder.IBAgent-iOS; the policy currently recognizes only ibtoold.

The standard signed-service matrix covers one service path only. Extend its same adopted, wrong-identity, lookalike and installed-authority assertions to the overlay service while preserving all refusal controls.
